notes.title: First update on language.
notes.content:
Hello. We are Zombie Buster VR development team.
First of all, thanks to the players who enjoyed zombie buster VR.
We've Updated Chinese and Korean language first.
You can change language in the game option.
We will be ready to support more languages ​​in the future.
